## CRON - Intent Stats Daily

**Issue:** #287
**RFC:** RFC-031 (Section 6.3, 13.4)

**Description:**
Calcule les métriques quotidiennes du système d'intent classification et les stocke dans PostgreSQL.

**Fréquence:** Daily à 04:00 AM

**Métriques calculées:**
- clarification_rate: % demandes nécessitant clarification
- accuracy: % predictions validées
- latency_p50, latency_p95, latency_p99
- total_requests, unique_users

**Output:** PostgreSQL `intent_metrics`

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO intent_metrics (
  stats_date,
  total_requests,
  unique_users,
  unique_guilds,
  clarification_rate,
  accuracy,
  latency_p50,
  latency_p95,
  latency_p99,
  domain_breakdown,
  created_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.stats_date }}',
  {{ $json.total_requests }},
  {{ $json.unique_users }},
  {{ $json.unique_guilds }},
  {{ $json.clarification_rate }},
  {{ $json.accuracy }},
  {{ $json.latency_p50 }},
  {{ $json.latency_p95 }},
  {{ $json.latency_p99 }},
  '{{ $json.domain_breakdown }}',
  '{{ $json.created_at }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (stats_date) DO UPDATE SET
  total_requests = EXCLUDED.total_requests,
  unique_users = EXCLUDED.unique_users,
  unique_guilds = EXCLUDED.unique_guilds,
  clarification_rate = EXCLUDED.clarification_rate,
  accuracy = EXCLUDED.accuracy,
  latency_p50 = EXCLUDED.latency_p50,
  latency_p95 = EXCLUDED.latency_p95,
  latency_p99 = EXCLUDED.latency_p99,
  domain_breakdown = EXCLUDED.domain_breakdown,
  created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at
